title: 第1章 圣地震惊天命所归出世即巅峰第2章 先天贴贴圣体越靠近女人修炼越快
slug: 三天大成了绝世剑仙童养夫
content_zh:
ps：观前提醒，本书主角走的盖世天骄无敌流，天生至尊，一路横推，所以会有很多特殊之处，请不要把普通小孩儿的印象代入到主角身上，这是玄幻体系，主角更是万古唯一，能讲道理的都不叫天骄，另外没有窝囊苟道，只有名为无敌的信念。
······
无尽疆域之外，太玄圣地深处。
沉寂已不知多少岁月，黑暗不见一丝光亮的石棺之中骤然升腾起青色的幽光。
一双瞳孔蓦然间睁开，其内呈现出阴阳二气流转。
却见这道苍老的身影猛然间挥动手掌，下一刻，一道水月镜盘骤然间在眼前展开。
水面中涟漪波动不止。
而老者一双阴阳双瞳则是死死的盯着那画中之景。
只见绵延不知道多少万里的天空之上没有任何一丝云朵的存在，但在常人所无法看到的景象内——
其虚空中仙鹤腾飞，祥兽起舞，三千佛陀映现，更有武仙人手执神兵凝化而来。
道道金黄色祥瑞之气粗壮如龙，从九天之上垂落而下，犹如星河倒挂，震撼人心。
金黄色雷霆犹如黄金浇筑一般在其中交织跳跃。
原本是为顶尖强者最为惊惧的九霄神雷，此刻竟是温驯如小兽，在其中形成无数电光盘旋，仅仅只是这无数异象蒸腾中的一道点缀！
而最令老者瞳孔紧缩的是，绵延数万里的金色法则气息竟是隐约间形成了一道撼天动地的大道金莲，将所有的异象给尽数囊括在内！
犹如一尊恐怖存在正以此为根基于天地中酝酿成型！
“大道金莲！”
这一刻，饶是以他活了漫长的悠久寿元也是忍不住倒吸一口凉气！
究竟是何方恐怖降世，竟是引得九霄神雷降世，天道赏赐，就连大道金莲都是予以祝福？
且天道为了予以保护，竟然将所有的异象都是以道则进行演化的，非九境以上强者就连窥视都无法做到！
常人更是对此毫无察觉。

一切的一切无不在彰显着——
天命所归，众星归位！
“东南方，大乾皇朝，有天命之物降世，速去，让圣女即刻前往。”
亘古幽幽之声带着数分焦急顷刻间席卷圣地。
······
天香国，白枫城。
“哇哇哇！——”
随着一声嘹亮清脆有力的婴儿啼哭声响起，所有正在将注意力投到此处的人都知道——
叶家第三代唯一的一名男婴诞生了。
身为白枫城四大家族之一的叶家，从出生起这名孩子就站在了无数人梦寐以求的高度，说是众星捧月也丝毫不为过。
房间中。
叶天澜睁开眼睛，揉了揉小手，一脸茫然的看着眼前的一切。
在明亮的灯光下离他最近的是一张苍老的慈蔼高兴面孔，以及三名中年男人。
还有在拼命将身体挤上前来，趴在床沿上一脸好奇的瞪着大眼睛看着自己的两个粉雕玉琢女童。
“这就是我这一世的家人吗···”
没错，他本不是这个世界的人，在机缘巧合下被大卡车击飞，随后翻滚三十六周半之后转世重生到了这个世界。
他是带着原有的意识来到这个世界的，自打他在母体中有意识起便能够清晰知晓自己的过往。
并且不知为何，自打娘胎里开始，他便感觉自己好像与生俱来有一些不对劲的地方。
最特别之处就在于——
他明明只是一个尚在母体之中的小胎儿，但却感觉自己好像浑身上下拥有着超越前世成年男人的强大力量。

并且这股力量竟然还在随着时间累积而不断变强！
身体最深处似乎还隐藏着某些暂时不能窥视的东西。
一粒金光在他眉心间犹如转轮不断流淌，更像一座门户，封印着不可预知的种种强大存在！
content_en:
ps: Before reading, please note that the protagonist of this book is in the unparalleled genius and invincible style. He is born supreme and pushed all the way, so there will be many special features. Please do not put the impression of ordinary children on the protagonist. This is a fantasy system, and the protagonist is the only one in the world. Those who can reason are not called geniuses. In addition, there is no coward, only the belief called invincibility.
······
Beyond the endless territory, deep in the Taixuan Holy Land.
It had been silent for an unknown number of years, and a cyan light suddenly rose from the dark sarcophagus without a trace of light.
A pair of pupils suddenly opened, showing the flow of yin and yang.
But he saw this old figure suddenly wave his palm, and the next moment, a water-moon mirror disk suddenly unfolded in front of his eyes.
There are ripples in the water.
The old man's pair of yin and yang eyes were staring at the scene in the painting.
I saw that there was no cloud in the sky that stretched for countless miles, but in a scene that ordinary people could not see——
In the void, cranes soared, auspicious beasts danced, three thousand Buddhas appeared, and even martial immortals came with magic weapons in their hands.
The golden auspicious aura is as strong as a dragon, hanging down from the nine heavens, like a galaxy hanging upside down, which is shocking.
The golden thunder intertwined and jumped in it like gold pouring.
The Nine Heavens Divine Thunder, which was originally the most feared by the top powerhouses, is now as docile as a small beast, forming countless electric lights circling in it, just an embellishment in the steaming of countless strange phenomena!
What made the old man's pupils shrink the most was that the aura of the golden law that stretched for tens of thousands of miles actually vaguely formed a heaven-shaking golden lotus, encompassing all the visions!
It's like a terrifying existence is taking shape in the heaven and earth based on this!
"Dao Jinlian!"
At this moment, even though he had lived a long life, he couldn't help but take a breath!
What kind of terrifying coming into the world actually caused the Nine Heavens Divine Thunder to come into the world, and was rewarded by heaven, and even the Golden Lotus of the Great Dao was blessed?
In addition, in order to protect it, the Dao of Heaven actually made all visions evolve according to the principles of the Dao. Even those who are not strong in the ninth realm or above cannot even peek!
Ordinary people are completely unaware of this.
Everything is manifested everywhere——
Where destiny has come, all the stars have returned!
"To the southeast, in the Daqian Dynasty, something destined by destiny has come to the world. Go quickly and let the saint go there immediately."
The eternal and faint voice suddenly swept through the Holy Land with some anxiety.
······
Tianxiang Kingdom, White Maple City.
"Wow wow wow!——"
As a loud, crisp, and powerful cry of a baby rang out, everyone who was paying attention here knew that——
The only baby boy of the third generation of the Ye family was born.
As one of the four major families in Bai Maple City, the Ye family, this child has stood at a height that countless people dream of since he was born. It is not an exaggeration to say that he is held in high esteem by all the stars.
in the room.
Ye Tianlan opened his eyes, rubbed his little hands, and looked at everything in front of him with a blank expression.
The ones closest to him under the bright light were an old, kind and happy face, and three middle-aged men.
There were also two girls who were trying their best to push their bodies forward, lying on the edge of the bed and staring at him with big eyes curiously on their faces.
"Is this my family in this life..."
That's right, he was not originally from this world. By chance, he was hit by a big truck and rolled over for thirty-six and a half weeks before being reincarnated into this world.
He came into this world with his original consciousness, and he has been able to clearly understand his past since he became conscious in the mother's body.
And for some reason, he felt like there was something wrong with him since he was born.
The most special thing is——
He is obviously just a little fetus still in the mother's womb, but he feels as if he has something beyond the adult man in his previous life.Great power.
And this power is actually getting stronger as time accumulates!
There seems to be something hidden in the deepest part of the body that cannot be seen for the time being.
A golden light was flowing between his eyebrows like a wheel, more like a portal, sealing all kinds of unpredictable powerful existences!
